sources.title: Squadra README
sources.locator: What Squadra does; Installation; First steps; Dashboard; Plugins; Commands; Operating boundaries
sources.finding: Skill + CLI + local dashboard coordinating Claude Code, Codex and Cursor windows through a shared SQLite registry with tasks, acknowledgements, executed proofs, independent reads and owner decisions; free MIT; Python 3.12+; macOS/POSIX tested; 66 subcommands.

sources.title: Privacy notice
sources.locator: What is stored; The Usage page; The dashboard and external services
sources.finding: Local registry (mode 0700/0600); no author-operated service; usage read from local Claude/Codex session files keeping token counts only; dashboard on 127.0.0.1 with access token and Host check; plugin secrets stored in plaintext files.

sources.title: Security policy
sources.finding: Latest release only receives fixes; private GitHub advisories.

sources.title: Work, proof and review
sources.locator: Assignment, proof, independent read, closure; automatic lanes; light route
sources.finding: Task assignment with owner/reader, ACK before start, frozen proved candidate, non-author review bound to the exact fingerprint, closure by coordinator; stale proof invalidates review; lanes split independent paths.

sources.title: Native runners
sources.finding: run starts a non-interactive Codex or Claude turn for reading or building; Cursor is refused; exit 0 alone is not a valid result.

sources.title: Recovery and dashboard page guide
sources.finding: Dashboard views, phone drawer layout, checkpoints, save/restore-check, window replacement and context handover.

sources.title: Usage reference
sources.finding: Local token usage by window/model/task read from Claude Code and Codex session files with optional user-priced estimates; no conversation text stored.

sources.title: Plugin contract
sources.finding: Local data plugins under ~/.squadra/plugins with producers; bundled catalogue (memoranda, Playwright, Sentry); no downloads or automatic execution by the dashboard.

sources.title: Squadra skill
sources.finding: Skill instructions agents follow for coordination, proof and review.

sources.title: Squadra CLI
sources.finding: Python stdlib CLI with subcommands init, agent, task, ack, prove, deliver, review, check, close, run, dash, usage, balance and more.

sources.title: Registry store
sources.finding: SQLite registry with hash-chained transactional events and content-addressed artifacts.

sources.title: Dashboard server
sources.finding: Local dashboard server with per-run access token, Host header allowlist for 127.0.0.1/localhost/[::1] and 403/401 refusals.

sources.title: Balance advisor

sources.title: Checklist
sources.finding: Read-only checks at resume, assignment, delivery and push.

sources.finding: Frequent releases through 3.15.1; no dated future commitments.
